notes.title: Fight or Flight - 0.40.9 - Hotfix
notes.content:
Small patch to fix some bugs i have found over the last few weeks :)

[b]Level[/b]; Rework to some of the factory area
[b]Level[/b]; Improvements to texturing in various area's along with optimization
[b]Air Drop[/b]; Fixed bug where the airdrop vehicle would sometimes spawn in incorrect location on clients
[b]Warm-up[/b]; Fixed bug with warm-up pawn not getting destroyed correctly at end of warm up
[b]Vehicles[/b]; Increased Max Rpm of all vehicles, increased "weight" of buggy
[b]UI[/b]; Fixed bug that let you change the minimum players required, then switch back to offline mode causing it to bug out

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Fight or Flight - 0.40.65 - Hotfix + Turbo
notes.content:
[b]Hi guys![/b]

There are a few little things that i think is important to point out in this patch.
First of all, I have added a turbo boost to the vehicles! :)
It can be used by holding your "Sprint" key while driving, there is a small blue bar under the RPM counter that shows how much boost you have remaining, once you stop using it, it will regenerate over time.
Second, something that has been requested quite a bit. When playing singleplayer (offline) mode you no longer have to wait for the 120 second warmup, this will be reduced to 5 seconds.
Third, Bots now dont spawn until 3 minutes into the match, this just gives you a little bit of time to get ready.

Next up i will be continuing to work on improvements to the level, such as making area's like the school and office blocks more dense.

Enjoy,
-[i]Gozu[/i]


[b]Vehicles[/b]; Added TURBO BOOST!
[b]Vehicles[/b]; Added more VFX
[b]Vehicles[/b]; Fixed replication glitch
[b]Player[/b]; Fixed bug when leaning and not in ADS mode
[b]Animation[/b]; Fixed animation bug when sprinting
[b]AI[/b]; Bots now wait 3 minutes before starting
[b]General[/b]; When playing in Offline mode you no longer have to wait 120 seconds for warmup
[b]General[/b]; Video memory optimisations (on going)
[b]General[/b]; Fixed various replication bugs
[b]Gamemode's[/b]; Increased zone shrink speed on all zone levels
[b]Gamemode's[/b]; Fixed bugs with BR game modes while playing in singleplayer mode
[b]Gamemode's[/b]; Improved and fixed various bugs with zone system in BR modes

notes.title: Fight or Flight - 0.40.63 - Hotfix
notes.content:

notes.title: Fight or Flight - 0.40.61 - Engine upgrade and more!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023766/0b7979f499ab4cd5a4174ffb1ac539d6867b0b19.png[/img]

[b]With this patch we have upgraded to Unreal Engine 4.26!!![/b]
4.26 gives us new rendering features, which we will be implementing in the coming months. With this change we have also implemented an experimental DX12 mode, which can be access by starting the game with the DX12 option.

In this patch we have also adjusted the height of the entire level, it is now ~15-20% higher, this means more hills, and provides a more interesting landscape :)


[i]Patch notes:[/i]
Level; Height and Verticality adjusted in level, entire level is now ~15-20% higher, this means more hills, higher hills and mountains, more interesting landscape!
Misc; Engine upgraded to Unreal 4.26.2
Misc; Added experimental DX12 mode, This can be accessed when starting the game by selecting the DX12 option on launch (please note it will give you an error when exiting the game, this is experimental and not recommended yet...)
Misc; Fixed bug preventing motion blur from working
AI; Fixed bug causing zombie AI to sometimes get confused when bot AI dies
Player; Fixed bug with weapon not un-holstering correctly sometimes
Player; Tweaked how weapon aim is handled in 3p mode to improve the experience
Player; Improved 3p camera
UI; Improved crosshair system, added dynamic crosshair for 3p mode which should improve the experience with hip fire
UI; Added audio volume slider for weapon shot sounds
UI; Weaponbar, removed "flare" from weapon bar and replaced with quickconsume of "painkillers"
Weapons; Increased density and radius of smoke grenades
Vehicles; Fixed some visual bugs with the Golf Cart


Notes; This patch requires that the key bindings are reset. This should happen automatically, but *if you have issues with controls* please go into the options, click on "bindings" then click the "reset" button and it should resolve the issues. Thanks!


Enjoy the patch, have fun!

notes.title: Fight or Flight - 0.40.6 - Patch notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023766/0b7979f499ab4cd5a4174ffb1ac539d6867b0b19.png[/img]


[b]New game mode![/b]
A new "Training" game mode has been added, this mode is similar to Drop Zone, but when you spawn in you get to pick from 4 differnt load outs.
These are [i]"Rifleman", "Support", "Marksman" and "Special Forces"[/i], Each class will spawn with a primary and secondary weapon and ammo!

[b]Audio improvements[/b]
A complete overhaul of all Spatilization and Occlusion for all sounds. This means that sounds will more accurately reflect the surroundings. It will now also be easier to pin-point the direction that the sound is coming from.

[b]Vehicle's improvements[/b]
A new "reset" feature for vehicles has been added, this can be triggered while the vehicle is at a complete stop (handbrake "right mouse", then press "R").
This is helpful for getting the vehicle unstuck if needed :)

[b]Menu changes for "PLAY" menu[/b]
This has been updated to now read:
FIND MATCH, BROWSE OFFICAL, BROWSE LOCAL, START OFFLINE.
You can start a single player match from the "Start Offline" option. The new Browse local option will show you LAN matches, and is a future place holder for open public hosted servers.



[i]Remaining fixes and changes as follows:[/i]
AI; Bots now use all the differnt weapons
AI; Bots now a bit harder, be careful! ;)
AI; Bug preventing alert sounds for Zombies, Wolves and Monsters from not playing now fixed
Audio; Fixed bug preventing volume levels from being applied correctly on launch
Level; Fixed bug with landscape looking too bright in certain situations
Misc; Random time of day settings will now favor day time
UI; Improvements to "Weapon" bar, Added icons for the quick use consumables, can now also be set to autohide, or off from the settings
UI; Improvements to "Vision" bar, can now also be set to autohide, or off from the settings
Zone; Zone sizes tweaked for all stages, zone now gets much smaller, sooner!!!



Enjoy the patch, have fun!

notes.title: Fight or Flight - 0.40.5.9 - Patch notes
notes.content:
This patch focuses mainly on bug fixes, and small QOL changes to improve the overall experience.

[b]Patch notes as follows;[/b]
UI; Improved item pickup/interaction UI, This now has 3 differnt options in the "UI" menu settings. Off, Small or Large. Default setting is "Small"
UI; Improved crosshair, also added hit marker cross
UI; Added hotkeys into inventory screen (same as weaponbar)
UI; Add FPS cap for menu, independent of game FPS cap
Animations; Tweaks to 1p crouch so that it looks smoother
Animations; Fixed bug with crouch animation causing a flicker in 1p
AI; Fixed speed of footstep sounds on bots, also have increased the volume slightly 
Player; Low health visual effect improved further, now shows effects when low health, as well as heart beat sounds, and shows the effects if bleeding out
Player; You can now switch weapons while in the inventory screen using the hotkeys
Weapons; Improved reload sounds for all Pistols, Revolvers, SMGs, and Assault Rifles
Vehicles; Fixed bug with zombies not getting damaged from vehicles
Vehicles; Improved vehicle FX (WIP placeholders)
Level; Lighting tweaks for all times of day. This is now locked in the singleplayer menu to 3 options Night,Morning and Day. (the best ones!)
Level; The large grey concrete buildings (old office sites) all now have interactable doors on the outsides, 
Level; Increased volume of sounds when opening and closing doors, and now wood doors will make differnt sounds to the steel ones
Loot; Increased loot spawns around old office sites
Misc; Fixed bug causing it to rain indoors!!!
Misc; Screen Space Global Illumination quality increased for "high" and "epic" settings (still "experimental" right now)
Misc; There has been a new server added into the match making for the "Oceania" region, this is just a test server right now, but feel free to use it!


Extra notes:
The number one complaint that we have had over the past few months has been about poor loot distribution, I just want you to know, that we hear yah!
There have been a number of small changes to the way the loot works in this patch, which should help a bit.
Over the next few weeks there will be a focus on fixing this issue!


Enjoy the patch, have fun!

notes.title: Fight or Flight - 0.40.5.81 - Hotfix
notes.content:
This is a small hotfix to fix a bug that snuck in after the latest patch.
The issue was critical enough to warrant a hot fix, as it was causing major issues for players when exiting vehicles.

A new vehicle has also been added as a surprise! ;-)

Vehicles; Fixed bug with character exit and entry rotation when vehicle is on slopes
Vehicles; New vehicle added!

notes.title: Fight or Flight - 0.40.5.8 - Patch notes
notes.content:
First off, apologies that this next patch has taken so long to complete, I'm sure this last few months have been challenging for everyone, so thanks to those that have been waiting patiently for the patch!

Going forward things should be much quicker now, and the patch frequency will be back to normal very shortly!

Here is a list of fixes and changes for this patch.

[b]Fight or Flight - 0.40.5.8 - Patch notes[/b]
Misc; Max player count increased to 64 players. Max bot amount increased to 60 for single player.
*NOTE*: Having 60 bots, and zombies and monsters will have drastic performance issues on older CPU's. Full bots, and no zombies should be okay on older cpu's...

Player; Increased player base health to 150
Player; Added 3p camera ("c") with freelook "alt", this is an *experiment* to see if the community likes it
Player; Player run speeds tweaked further, player can get 15% faster by holstering their weapon "x", also tweaked strafe speed while sprinting...
Player; Removed the "roll" from the camera bob
Player; Can now consume consumables while walking
Player; Low health visual effect improved
Player; Small changes to cosmetics so that certain hands match top color better
Player; Fixed bug causing Warmup loadout to not get ammo some times
UI; Alive player count added to player minimap for br modes
AI; Fixed bugs causing monsters to enter houses
Loot; Increased amount of armor loot
Loot; Increased amount of G18 and M9 pistols
Level; Lighting re-done for all times of day (my fav is 6:45am! please note this is still WIP)
Misc; Improvements to server memory use, should result in less hitching
Misc; New menu music added!

notes.title: Fight or Flight - 0.40.5.71 - Hotfix, Bugs and Sounds...
notes.content:
A small hotfix after some feedback from this weeks patch :)


AI; Bot AI shot cool down times tweaked, 90 and 100 skill will range from about 0.25s to 0.5s with some rng
AI; Fixed bug where bot would fire blanks on first shot after switching weapons
Weapons; New sounds for AAR56, RU74, RU105, RU74S (please keep in mind these are all work in progress, good sound takes a lot of time to get right :)

This will be the last patch for the year, thanks for all your feedback, it has helped us make massive improvements already!
I hope that you all get some time over Christmas/New Years to have some matches!
[i]And please keep the feedback / suggestions coming it is very much appreciated.[/i]

I will still be around to talk / take feedback, so join in on discord / forums for discussions and together we can make this an awesome game :)

[url=https://discord.gg/asUYQcM]https://discord.gg/asUYQcM[/url]

GLHF

notes.title: 0.40.5.3 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
This patch is focused on fixing up some small bugs, and improving the weapon scopes.

[b]Fight or Flight - 0.40.5.3 - Patch Notes[/b]
-----------------------------------------
UI; Selecting "Auto" in match making region will now calculate the best region for you based off latency
UI; Inventory, dragging an equipment item onto an already equipped item will now replace currently equipped item!!
Level; Fixed issue with bullets and windows on houses (you can now shoot through windows, destructible windows are planned for the future...)
Vehicles; Improved speed of entering vehicle, you can now start driving faster :)
Vehicles; Fixed bug occurring with hitboxes after exiting vehicle
Weapons; All rifles iron sights zeroed to 100m
Weapons; All scopes zeroed to 100m
Weapons; Part of the weapon sway system has now been removed, it was making lining up the scopes too inconsistent and hard, this will make sniping a bit more enjoyable


As the dust is settling now we will be shifting our focus more towards the level, adding more buildings and expanding on area's.

I would like to welcome all the new players to the game! Feel free to jump onto our discord where we have a small growing community.
[url=https://discord.gg/asUYQcM]Discord Group[/url]

GLHF!

notes.title: 0.40.5.2 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
This patch is mainly focused on the AI improvements, and cleaning up a few things after everyone's feedback.

[b]Fight or Flight - 0.40.5.2 - Patch Notes[/b]
-----------------------------------------
Bots; Bot skill option added in menu, scale 0-100, This is very basic at the moment and will change the bots vision and rate of fire (will be expanded on)
AI; Fixed various bugs with AI's, they can now keep up with player better
UI; Improvements to server browser
UI; Killfeed simplified for killed by zone or environmental damage
Character; Improved vaulting system to make it smoother
Character; Decrease strafe and backwards walking speeds slightly, this is so when trying to escape a zombie or monster the player can no longer run backwards to avoid them
Weapons; SVD rate of fire increased
Weapons; SKS now also semi auto with increased rate of fire, I will be adding bolt rifles back in the future.

[i]Known issues: Bullets will despawn when shot through glass on houses, this will be resolved with the next patch (will be large)[/i]



I hope you enjoy these changes, Setting the zombie rate to 4x is lots of chaotic fun! :>
GLHF!

notes.title: 0.40.5.1 - Hotfix Patch Notes
notes.content:
We have just applied a small hotfix that addresses a few small issues.


Matchmake; Server and client issues resolved. Matchmaking now occurs in about 2 minutes. Join the discord if you are having issues finding matches, help us grow the community!
UI; Server browser implemented, this can be found under "play" and "search", this can help people joining games with their friends until the player base grows more, please remember the game is new! :)
UI; Zombie spawn rate option added for local matches, "play", "start local" can be set to 2x,3x,4x, please note this can affect performance on weaker CPU's.
Loot; Loot levels tweaked for weapons (this will take time to improve and likely need more tweaking)
Weapons; SVD changed to semi auto rifle like IRL


For the next patch some more of the suggestions from players will be implemented, and bugs fixed.
Thank you for all the feedback that has been given so far on the forums and on discord, and thanks for supporting FOF on its early access journey!


Also a small mention that we are actively engaging with many streamers in an effort to get the game more known and grow the player base!

GLHF!
https://discord.gg/asUYQcM
